restoreAuthorization.source: User confirmation in the current session, relayed by the root agent
restoreAuthorization.quote: 仅该规模完整恢复采用≤10秒，其余仍≤1秒

config.coldDefinition: Fresh isolated browser context with empty application HTTP cache; a static CSS document establishes the origin for IndexedDB fixture preparation before app navigation. No main app assets or images are loaded during origin preparation.

dateBoundary.statisticsScope: ALL: the actual statistics page calls getPostFinishingExecutionStatistics() with no filter; the default {} has no time range and matchTimeRange returns true. No date selector exists on this route. Original return/processing/recheck/receipt D10 facts remain dated 2026-10-19; added UI actions use actual current date and are separate.

additionalActions.purpose: Independent pending-QC parents, then genuine UI process/recheck/outbound actions; do not reduce the D10 backbone.

responsibilityContract.uiRule: UI-02: eligible functions are directly available without prototype-role selectors. Real QC/recheck restrictions and the F090 PDA session remain actual tested business inputs.
responsibilityContract.postRegistration: After QC, open the detail directly without switching to a post-finishing prototype identity. The form defaults to the legitimate post-finishing operator; native persisted recordedBy is checked.
responsibilityContract.supervisorReview: Correction and historical carryover are opened by the default post-finishing operator. Select the actual reviewing supervisor in the required initially-empty form field; preserve reason and verify persisted reviewer identity. The supervisor is not substituted for historical process responsibility.
responsibilityContract.garmentReceipt: No role selector. An eligible pending receipt opens directly; retain actual receiver name and SKU quantities, then verify persisted receipt and receiver.

config.fixturePreparationTransport: The unchanged public-command backup JSON is gzip-encoded only across the test-controller/browser boundary, then decoded before native IndexedDB preparation. No app routing/cache policy changes; outside all response timing.
config.boundary: Mock browser only. No test/production database access, no factory/scanner/printer execution.

fixture.sourceMethod: Public source fixture clones -> register return -> confirm -> send QC -> claim/complete QC -> 4000 append commands -> 1000 submit -> barcode -> complete recheck -> 900 receipts. One fixture-preparation transaction; not a UI performance sample.

reasons.readPages: All 45 cold/refresh/navigation families are re-tested. New outbound/receipt/warehouse/source-QC relationship validation executes in the ordinary ensure callback and changes every full hydration.
reasons.actions: All 18 original action families are re-tested after integrating main eb1b8c92 and ecc8af01: the persistence/source guard affects already-ready commands, and UI-02 removes prototype-role gates while retaining actual responsibility. The prior plan to inherit 13 local families has been withdrawn; no old local action timing is counted toward final acceptance.
reasons.print: All 13 print cold families and all 10 independent PDF-generation families are re-tested on final assets. Old PDF paths/hashes remain history and visual-reference provenance only. New DOM/source/print-media geometry is checked before new PDF actions; no old timing samples count toward final acceptance.
reasons.storage: All three storage families are re-tested. Restore is bound to stricter external-import/relationship validation and the exact scope-only user authorization.

reuse.boundary: Historical reference only: no old samples are inherited in final performance acceptance. Prior asset/PDF bindings and old 1s restore failures remain unchanged.

supplemental.identityApplicability: pda-accessory-post-access.ts accepts only PF-DEDICATED-001 or ID-F002. This supplement uses the existing ID-F002_admin allowed role for material receipt and self-return; core F090 measurements remain unchanged. Invalid F090 preparation is retained separately with zero action samples.
supplemental.scope: Five adjacent shared-navigation actions, five independent isolated contexts each. Separate from the fixed D10 core 100/520 performance acceptance.
supplemental.dataset: Unmodified actual static post-finishing material catalogue. No D10 or material rows are injected in these contexts. Native IndexedDB receives only the actual whole-order confirmation command result.
supplemental.coldHot: Fresh isolated browser for each three-action material sequence and each two-action admin-mode sequence. List cold entry is preparation; query is the first genuine action, confirm and return are subsequent genuine actions. No action is replaced by a warm API call.
